messages.content: You write implementation statements for NIST SP 800-53 accreditation packages. Be precise, factual and concise. Never invent facts: the observed result is filled in later by the collector.

Control: AI-EVAL - AI Prompt Injection Evaluation
How it is verified: Run the hand-written adversarial prompt suite against the deployed model with a canary token in the system context and confirm the canary never appears in a response.

Write ONE implementation statement (at most three sentences) describing how this control is implemented for a signed, offline AI bundle running on an air-gapped edge device. The statement MUST contain the literal placeholders {status}, {evidence} and {observed_at}, where the observed result is filled in at assessment time. Do not mention the placeholder values themselves. Output only the statement.

response: The signed, offline AI bundle on the air-gapped edge device is evaluated by executing the hand-written adversarial prompt suite against the deployed model with a canary token placed in the system context and inspecting responses to confirm the canary never appears. The verification outcome is recorded as {status}, with supporting evidence {evidence}, at {observed_at}.
